abort.already_configured: This Octopus Energy Japan login is already configured
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Octopus Energy Japan
abort.device_code_expired: The device code expired before access was approved. Start again to get a new code.
abort.device_grant_unavailable: Octopus Energy Japan did not accept a device-code sign-in for this client. Use the account sign-in instead.
abort.missing_credentials: Add an application credential first. Home Assistant needs the public OAuth client ID that Octopus Energy Japan issues for this integration, under Settings > Devices & services > Application credentials. Octopus Energy Japan has not issued one yet, so setup cannot be completed.
abort.my_home_assistant_required: My Home Assistant must be enabled. Signing in to Octopus Energy Japan returns you through my.home-assistant.io, which is the single redirect address registered for this integration. Without it, Octopus Energy Japan would reject the sign-in with an error of its own. Add "my:" to your configuration.yaml, or restore "default_config:", then restart Home Assistant.
abort.no_historical_resources: No historical accounts or supply points were discovered
abort.oauth_identity_unavailable: The authenticated Octopus Energy Japan user could not be identified
abort.oauth_metadata_unavailable: OAuth configuration is awaiting confirmation from Octopus Energy Japan
abort.reconfigure_unavailable: Resource discovery is not currently available; reload the integration and try again

error.invalid_auth: Octopus Energy Japan rejected that email address and password
error.unknown: Octopus Energy Japan returned an unexpected response

device.title: Sign in with a device code
device.description: Home Assistant will show a code to enter on the Octopus Energy Japan website. Nothing is typed here and no browser redirect is involved, so this works on a Home Assistant with no public address.

password.title: Sign in with email and password
password.description: Enter the email address and password you use for Octopus Energy Japan. Both are stored in Home Assistant so the integration can sign in again when the provider's seven-day refresh token expires. Switch to the account sign-in later and the stored password is deleted.

reauth_confirm.description: Continue to Octopus Energy Japan to renew access.
reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Octopus Energy Japan

reconfigure.description: Active accounts and supply points are always enabled. Selecting an ended account enables all of its supply points; ended supply points under an active account can be selected individually.
reconfigure.title: Manage historical OEJP resources

user.title: Choose how to sign in
user.description:
**Octopus Energy Japan account (recommended)** signs you in on the OEJP website. This integration never sees your password. It needs an OAuth client ID, which OEJP has not issued yet.

**Email and password** uses the provider's older login. It works today, but OEJP has already removed these fields from its published API schema and can stop accepting them without notice. Your password is stored in Home Assistant, because the provider's refresh token lasts only seven days and nothing else can renew it.

progress.wait_for_device: Open {url} and enter the code **{user_code}**, then approve access. This page continues on its own once you do.

application_credentials.description:
Enter the public OAuth client ID that Octopus Energy Japan issued for this integration.

Leave the client secret empty. This integration is a public client and must never hold a secret, because anything shipped to every installation is not secret.

OEJP has not issued a client ID yet and offers no self-service registration, so there is currently no value to enter. Progress is tracked in the project's OAuth application status document.

capability_unavailable.title: Octopus Energy Japan is not serving a reading method
capability_unavailable.description: These reading capabilities are unavailable for your account: {capabilities}. The integration falls back to whichever method still works, so consumption usually keeps recording. If every method is listed, no new readings can be collected.

commercial_permission_missing.title: Octopus Energy Japan did not grant access to some account details
commercial_permission_missing.description: Your authorization does not cover: {features}. Consumption, totals, and Energy Dashboard statistics are unaffected. The entities for the listed information stay unavailable.

ledger_partitions_corrupt.title: Some stored Octopus Energy Japan history could not be read
ledger_partitions_corrupt.description: {count} month(s) of stored readings failed to load and were quarantined so the rest of your history stays usable. Recent readings continue to be recorded, but totals and Energy Dashboard statistics for the affected months may be incomplete. Removing and re-adding the integration re-downloads the current and previous month.

readings_silent.title: Octopus Energy Japan has not sent new readings
readings_silent.description: {count} reading series has produced nothing for more than {hours} hours. Half-hourly readings normally arrive several hours late, so a short gap is expected, but a longer silence usually means the meter data has not reached Octopus Energy Japan yet. No action is needed here; the integration keeps retrying and fills the gap once the data appears.

tariff_history_unreadable.title: Stored rate adjustments could not be read
tariff_history_unreadable.description: The archive of past fuel-cost adjustments and levies for {count} supply point(s) could not be read, so hours from earlier periods are priced with the rate Octopus Energy Japan reports now. The file is deliberately not overwritten: the provider does not serve a past adjustment again, so replacing it would destroy the only copy. Consumption and energy statistics are unaffected. If this persists, attach your diagnostics to an issue.

tariff_not_priceable.title: A tariff Octopus Energy Japan reports cannot be priced
tariff_not_priceable.description: Octopus Energy Japan reports a plan this integration cannot turn into a cost ({reasons}). Consumption, calendar totals, and the Energy Dashboard energy statistics are unaffected; only the cost statistic is not published. Nothing needs doing, and there is no setting that changes it. Pricing part of such a plan and ignoring the rest would look like a working cost while being wrong.

coordinator_unavailable.message: The integration is still starting, so its entities cannot be added yet.

credentials_missing.message: The stored email and password are gone. Reconnect the integration to sign in again.

credentials_rejected.message: Octopus Energy Japan rejected the stored email and password. Reconnect with your current password.

discovery_failed.message: Your accounts and supply points could not be read. Check the diagnostics download.

discovery_unavailable.message: Reading your accounts and supply points is temporarily unavailable. Home Assistant will retry.

metadata_unavailable.message: Octopus Energy Japan's sign-in service is temporarily unavailable. Home Assistant will retry.

oauth_implementation_unavailable.message: The OAuth credentials for this entry could not be loaded. Check Application credentials.

oauth_server_unavailable.message: Octopus Energy Japan's OAuth server is temporarily unavailable. Home Assistant will retry.

oauth_token_invalid.message: The stored token was rejected. Reconnect the integration.

oauth_token_request_failed.message: Requesting a token from Octopus Energy Japan failed. Home Assistant will retry.

readings_failed.message: Consumption data could not be read. Check the diagnostics download.

readings_unavailable.message: Consumption data is temporarily unavailable. Home Assistant will retry on the next update.

reauth_required.message: The authorization for Octopus Energy Japan has expired. Reconnect the integration.

shutting_down.message: The integration is shutting down, so no new data was fetched.

sign_in_unavailable.message: Signing in to Octopus Energy Japan is temporarily unavailable. Home Assistant will retry.

storage_unavailable.message: Home Assistant could not write to its own storage, so this update was not saved. Check the disk and the configuration directory.

unsupported_auth_method.message: This entry uses a sign-in method this version does not know: {method}. It was most likely created by a newer version of the integration.
